description: Information theory decomposed. Differential entropy, rate-distortion theory, network information theory, error-correcting codes (Reed-Solomon, LDPC, polar, turbo), Kolmogorov complexity, algorithmic information, MDL principle.

sub_mechanisms.name: differential_entropy
sub_mechanisms.definition: h(X) = -∫p log p dx for continuous X.
sub_mechanisms.why: Generalises discrete entropy. Gaussian maximises for given variance. Foundation continuous information.

sub_mechanisms.name: rate_distortion_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Minimum rate to encode source with distortion ≤ D. R(D) curve.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation lossy compression. JPEG, MP3. R-D theorem characterises optimum.

sub_mechanisms.name: Reed_Solomon_codes
sub_mechanisms.definition: Block codes over finite field. Corrects t errors in 2t parity symbols.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. CDs, QR codes, deep space. Standard error correction.

sub_mechanisms.name: LDPC_codes
sub_mechanisms.definition: Low-Density Parity-Check. Sparse parity matrix. Near-Shannon capacity.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern coding. 5G, Wi-Fi 6, hard drives. Iterative decoding.

sub_mechanisms.name: polar_codes
sub_mechanisms.definition: Arıkan 2009. Channel polarisation. Provably achieves capacity.
sub_mechanisms.why: First constructive capacity-achieving codes. 5G control channel. Foundation modern.

sub_mechanisms.name: turbo_codes
sub_mechanisms.definition: Parallel concatenation with interleaver. Iterative decoding.
sub_mechanisms.why: Revolutionary 1993. Near-Shannon performance. 3G/4G. Foundation iterative decoding.

sub_mechanisms.name: Kolmogorov_complexity
sub_mechanisms.definition: K(x) = length of shortest program outputting x. Uncomputable but meaningful.
sub_mechanisms.why: Algorithmic information theory. Foundation. Distinguishes random from compressible.

sub_mechanisms.name: minimum_description_length
sub_mechanisms.definition: MDL: best model minimises code length(model) + code length(data | model).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern statistics + ML. Trades complexity vs fit. Bayesian connection.

sub_mechanisms.name: channel_capacity_AWGN
sub_mechanisms.definition: C = B log(1 + SNR) for additive white Gaussian noise channel.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation wireless. Shannon-Hartley formula. Dictates achievable rates.

sub_mechanisms.name: network_information_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Multi-user channels. Broadcast, multiple access, relay. Capacity regions.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern wireless. 5G beyond. Cell-free networks.

sub_mechanisms.name: Slepian_Wolf_distributed
sub_mechanisms.definition: Encode correlated sources separately, decode jointly. Achieves H(X,Y) rate.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation distributed compression. Sensor networks. Surprising result.

sub_mechanisms.name: Fisher_information
sub_mechanisms.definition: I(θ) = E[(∂log p/∂θ)²]. Curvature of log-likelihood.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation statistics. Cramér-Rao bound: variance ≥ 1/I. Modern: natural gradient.

derivation_rules.name: Gaussian_maximises_differential_entropy
derivation_rules.why: Foundation. Maximum entropy principle. Justifies normal in inference + estimation.

derivation_rules.name: rate_distortion_curve_characterises_compression
derivation_rules.why: Foundation. JPEG, MP3 approach but don't reach. Modern: learned compressors approaching.

derivation_rules.name: modern_codes_approach_capacity
derivation_rules.why: Foundation modern communications. Within 1 dB of Shannon. 5G uses LDPC + polar.

derivation_rules.name: Kolmogorov_complexity_uncomputable_but_useful
derivation_rules.why: Uncomputable (Chaitin) but theoretically meaningful. Foundation algorithmic info theory.

derivation_rules.name: MDL_balances_fit_complexity
derivation_rules.why: Bayesian + information theory unite. Code length = -log probability. Standard model selection.
